messages:
lee: Hey team, need to swap my primary for 2026-03-18 22:00-10:00 UTC. Kid's surgery moved up, can't guarantee availability. Sorry for the scramble.

lee: Quick context: earlier today we saw transient errors from embedding-service that triggered a few pages (mostly 502s). incident-bot cleared it but worth a heads up for the overnight window — BetaInc has a heavy ingest at ~03:30 UTC so keep an eye on embeddings error-rate and queue-depth.

incident-bot: [ALERT CLEAR] embedding-service-5xx-rate (>2%) resolved at 2026-03-17T19:45Z. No active incidents.

lee: Runbook links: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/oncall/embeddings-errors and https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/lee-templates. Quick mitigation notes:
```
# quick mitigations
1) check /dashboards/embeddings/health-betainc
2) if 5xx spikes -> restart embedding-worker group: /ops/ecs/restart embedding-worker-prod --cluster embeddings-prod
3) if queue_depth > 1000 -> enable fallback-rate-limit: /ops/traffic/fallback --service embeddings --ratio 0.5
```

mika: I can pick up primary for that window if chris is okay to be secondary. I won't be on travel that weekend.

chris: I can do secondary. I'll also shadow pre-shift with mika tonight to make sure runbook steps are clear.

mika: Thanks. Lee, can you export your recent pager trace and drop it in the handoff doc? `/oncall history lee 48h` should do it. Also any open customer notes?

lee: pager history exported and linked in the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/lee-2026-03-18. No open customer escalations but BetaInc had one ticket about slow embeddings last week (ticket #INC-8942).

ops-bot: Oncall swap requested: lee -> mika for 2026-03-18 22:00-10:00 UTC. Please confirm by reacting :thumbsup: or running `/oncall confirm-swap 2323004321`.

mika: I'll run pre-shift checks tonight and post results. Planning to set alert-sensitivity to "lean" for embeddings to reduce chattiness.

chris: FYI for BetaInc: if you see sustained error-rate >2% during their batch window, escalate to infra-dedicated and kick off the fallback rate-limit. Add "BetaInc" to the incident title so customer success gets routed.

mika: Noted. I'll also add a short escalation matrix in the incident tracker.

mika: Running pre-checks now:
```
# pre-shift checks 2026-03-18
curl -fsS https://api.internal.redwood/ping || echo 'api unreachable'
curl -fsS http://embeddings-internal/health | jq .status
# check queue depth
curl -fsS http://embeddings-internal/metrics | grep queue_depth
```

mika: Pre-checks look clean. embedding worker count = 24, queue_depth = 12, 5xx rate = 0.4%. Ran a smoke embedding request, got 200 and vector length as expected. Ready to be primary.

ops-bot: Oncall swap confirmed: primary=mika, secondary=chris for 2026-03-18 22:00-10:00 UTC. Change recorded by ops-bot at 2026-03-17T22:12Z.

lee: Thanks both. Left extra notes in the doc about the BetaInc batch (time, expected throughput, sample logs). Appreciate the cover.

mika: I'll be on pager and reachable on DM. If anything looks like customer-impacting (>1% user-facing errors) I'll escalate immediately and call the dedicated infra pager.

chris: Standing by as secondary during the shift. I'll monitor #eng-oncall and the alerts channel.

incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled rotation change for mika at 2026-03-18T22:00Z. Pager targets and calendar updated.
